orientation.summary: The one-piece candidate is registered on its 80 mm disc foot and embedded in that manufacturing orientation.

supports.summary: Automatic tree support from the build plate is embedded because the support-free control slice reported floating petal regions; removal access requires human preview and physical verification.

limitations: P2 is digital evidence only and is not physical, rights, safety, appearance or commercial approval.
The whole-product concept remains pending owner approval and is not evidence that Gate 0B was historically completed.
The current-model render and 3MF represent the unrepaired Step1X body with the owner-authorized disc foot.
Part-list completeness and support removal remain subject to product-owner review.
